title: Datadog US1 - October Scheduled Maintenance Window
text:
Service: Datadog US1
Maintenance: October Scheduled Maintenance Window
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2016-10-07T21:00:00.000-04:00
Scheduled until: 2016-10-07T21:45:00.000-04:00
Updates:
- 2016-10-07T21:11:14.759-04:00: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2016-10-07T21:01:56.335-04:00: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2016-10-07T20:00:01.394-04:00: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2016-10-03T10:16:41.452-04:00: scheduled - We will be performing proactive maintenance for a window of no longer than 45 minutes 
The window will start at 2016-10-07 21:00 EST (2016-10-08 01:00 UTC). 
During this period, you may come across our 'down' page, but that is to be expected. There may be a brief period during this maintenance window when alerts may not be sent. In this event, we will keep our Status Page updated here. 
*Most importantly*, all of your data will be processed. 
If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@datadoghq.com
